TEAM NAME: Science and Speed Synergy
FIGHTERS: Tennis Ball, Test Tube, Leafy, Pencil
SIDE BID (asymmetric maps): our preferred side, 5 points
PRESET: none
BUILD SETUPS: choke, stunland, airlock, wallshort
OFFENCE PLAYS: scout, boostrun, thirdreturn, carrierhide
DEFENCE TACTICS: choke, zone, layers, chip
ROLES: Tennis Ball = def, Test Tube = def, Leafy = runner, Pencil = att
JOBS: choke: Tennis Ball, Test Tube; scout: Leafy; boostrun: Pencil
AREAS: Tennis Ball = our home, Test Tube = our approach, Leafy = enemy home, Pencil = enemy approach
BUILD POINTS:
- Tennis Ball: 4 walls (12 points), 1 trap (stun pad) (5 points), 3 props (3 points)
- Test Tube: 3 traps (stun pads/spikes) (15 points), 1 wall (3 points), 2 props (2 points)
- Leafy: 2 traps (springs) (10 points), 5 platforms (10 points)
- Pencil: 2 traps (springs) (10 points), 5 platforms (10 points)
FLAG HIDING:
- Tennis Ball: our home, hidden behind a crate prop
- Test Tube: our home, hidden behind a barrel prop
- Leafy: our approach, hidden behind a bush prop
- Pencil: our approach, hidden behind a curtain prop
OFFERS: Accept both +10 points deal; refuse any deals where our team loses points relative to the opponent.
ADAPTATION: if our team has captured 3 flags and needs 1 more: Pencil switches to def to secure our home. If 2 or more teammates are in jail: Leafy breaks away from raiding to prioritize a jailbreak rescue.
REASONING: This composition balances heavy area denial with unmatched hyper-mobility. Tennis Ball and Test Tube dominate defensive play; Tennis Ball's turret/mines combined with Test Tube's tracking darts and shattering poison glass establish an impenetrable zone at our choke points, scaling damage to trigger easy jail thresholds. Offensively, Leafy leverages the invincible BFDIA Sprint to cross massive screens seamlessly and safely bypass traps, while Pencil uses Supervan to safely ram through defenders and cross diverse terrain types on any map. By splitting roles strictly between two heavy lane-anchors and two elite rush-down threats, opponents are starved of flag captures while our runners rapidly secure wins via the third-area return routes.
